# White-balanced camera RGB -> linear sRGB (D65), for prism --raw-camera-matrix.
# Generated by prism_profile 0.1.0 from the LightCraft camera profile
#   assets/camera-profiles/ILCE-7RM5.json
#   model ILCE-7RM5, profile version 1, fitted on 220 photos (790553 colour pairs)
#   in LightCraft (github.com/storytold/lightcraft), added in PR #3022 (commit c7961df1)
#   calibrated by the Prism author from their own α7R V shots
#
# LightCraft's matrix maps white-balanced camera RGB -> linear Rec. 2020:
#     1.249584733  -0.330057011   0.077385243
#    -0.093711165   1.203874393  -0.112013150
#    -0.034228324  -0.868817228   1.937872050
# Converted as normalize_rows(XYZ->sRGB * Rec2020->XYZ * matrix); both spaces are D65,
# so no chromatic adaptation. Row sums before normalising: 0.9934 0.9980 1.0392
#
# The profile was fitted to the camera's own JPEGs, so this is a camera-JPEG look
# (more saturated, like the in-camera style), not a colorimetric calibration.
# Skipped: the profile's hue/saturation/value table (72x5x5), which a 3x3 matrix cannot represent.
